# Workspace for users, teams and their agents to collaborate.

Your AI makes something: a website idea, an app for the offsite, an investigation diagram, an explanation of GPUs. Spacesheep turns it into a shareable space. Share it with everyone, with friends, with a few people you pick, or just look at it yourself from a bigger screen.

Create a documentDescribe what you need and build it here.   Use with your AI chatConnect ChatGPT, Claude, Codex, or Cursor.

Sign in

Try now

### Ask your Claude or Codex:

`Use spacesheep.dev and give a visual explanation of how GPUs work.`

Paste it into any assistant that can browse. It reads the setup page, makes the space, and sends you the link.

Works with [...] |  | Chat artifactClaude, ChatGPT | Shared docGoogle Docs, Notion | Spacesheep |
 ---  --- |
| Made by any AI | Only that vendor’s model | You paste it in | Any agent, any model, or a text message |
| A change costs | The whole document again | Your own typing | Only the block that changed |
| Changes appear live | After the rewrite | As you type | Streamed into every open tab |
| Comments and reactions | None | Yes | On every block |
| Apps and realtime games | Static only | No | Built-in storage and rooms |
| Who read it | No | Limited | Readers, depth, reactions |
| Works from Telegram, Slack, iMessage | No | No | Yes, photos and voice too |
| Enterprise and consumer | Consumer | Both, but no agents | Orgs and access tiers, shaped like a link you text a friend | [...] Spacesheep is the surface where that lands. Simple, visual, shared. A new place for humans to work while the agents do the rest.

In short

AI will write more than you can ever read. Spacesheep turns it into things you can see.

results.title: 8 Top Read.ai Alternatives in 2026 [Free Tools + Use Cases]
results.content:
Pros

 Highly customizable summaries
 Fits existing documentation workflow
 Strong collaboration features

Cons

 Requires manual copy-paste
 No automatic meeting capture

Pricing: AI add-on from ~$10 per user/month

Best for: Teams refining summaries inside docs

## Free Read.ai Alternatives

Free plans are often where teams start, but also where limitations show up fastest.

Several Read.ai alternatives offer free plans or trials, including Fireflies.ai, tl;dv, Supernormal, and Sembly AI. These usually include basic meeting recording and AI-generated summaries, with limits on meeting volume, storage, exports, or integrations.

When free plans work well: [...] ### For Personal Meeting Notes

Read.ai is usually enough for individuals who want lightweight summaries for their own reference. Alternatives like Supernormal or MeetJamie often win here by producing cleaner, more readable summaries with less noise and less editing required.

Recommendation: Choose the tool whose summaries you’d actually reread a week later.

### For Team Collaboration

Read.ai summaries can be shared, but collaboration is limited. Tools like Fireflies.ai or Notion AI work better when notes need to be reviewed, edited, commented on, or reused across teams and projects.

Recommendation: If notes live beyond the meeting, prioritize tools that fit naturally into shared docs or team workflows.

### For Sales Calls [...] ## Why Teams Upgrade from Read.ai to Cirrus Insight

Read.ai helps teams capture meetings. Cirrus Insight helps them do something with them.

Where Read.ai focuses on summaries, Cirrus Insight focuses on execution, connecting meetings to follow-ups, CRM updates, and real pipeline movement inside Salesforce.

For sales teams, that difference matters because Cirrus Insight:

 Delivers AI-powered meeting prep so reps show up informed, not scrambling
 Turns conversations into clear next steps, not static notes
 Automatically updates Salesforce, reducing post-meeting admin
 Supports coaching and deal reviews with conversation intelligence, not just transcripts
